paper.title: Best-of-three-worlds Analysis for Linear Bandits with Follow-the-regularized-leader Algorithm

settings.name_in_paper: Linear bandits in adversarial environment (non-oblivious adversary)
unmapped: Finite arm set D spanning R^d with ||x||_2<=1 and ||theta_t||_2<=1; K denotes |D|
Noise assumed zero in adversarial environment
settings.definition_quote: For linear bandits in \textit{adversarial environment}, $\theta_t$ is chosen by an adversary arbitrarily in each round $t$. In this work, we consider the non-oblivious adversary, which means that the choice of $\theta_t$ may potentially depend on the history of the learner's actions

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic linear bandits with corruption (adversarial regime with a (Delta, C, T) self-bounding constraint)
unmapped: Noise only stated as independent zero-mean; proof uses |l_t(x_t)|<=1 (losses in [-1,1] rather than [0,1])
Corruptions c_t arbitrary (not necessarily linear in x_t), C = sum_t |c_t|; C unknown to the learner
Finite arm set D spanning R^d, ||x||_2<=1, ||theta||_2<=1; K denotes |D|
settings.definition_quote: For the corrupted stochastic environment, it is also satisfied that $\theta_t=\theta$ for some \textit{unknown} $\theta$, but the learner now receives loss $\ell_t(x_t)=\left\langle x_t,\theta \right\rangle+\epsilon_t\left(x_t\right)+c_t$, where $c_t$ is the corrupted value chosen by the adversary in each round $t$ ... let $C=\sum_{t=1}^T|c_t|$ be the corruption level

algorithms.name: FTRL for Linear Bandits (negative entropy regularizer with G-optimal design exploration)
requires_knowledge_of: arm set D and its G-optimal design

symbols.K: |D|, number of arms in the finite arm set

source.label: thm:thmregret
source.quote: Choose $\psi_t(p) = -\beta_t H(p)$ and $\gamma_t = \min\sets{g(\pi)/\beta_t,1/2 }$ ... In the adversarial environment, regret can be upper bounded by $R(T) \le O\bracket{\sqrt{dT\ln T \ln(|D|T)}}$

results.notes: Regret defined as expected pseudo-regret. Learning rate uses ln T, so horizon known. Compute polynomial in |D|.

symbols.K: |D|, number of arms in the finite arm set

source.label: thm:thmregret
source.quote: In the stochastic environment with corruption level $C$, the regret can be bounded by $R(T) \le O \bracket{\frac{ d\ln T \ln (|D|T) }{ \Delta_{\min}} + \sqrt{\frac{Cd\ln T \ln (|D|T)}{\Delta_{\min}}} }$, where $\Delta_{\min}=\min_{x\in D,x\neq x^*}\Delta(x)$

results.notes: Holds more generally in the adversarial regime with (Delta,C,T) self-bounding constraint; C=0 gives the pure stochastic bound. C not needed by algorithm.
